claim_under_pricing: Implementation smoke only: add a non-default high-speed obs72 normalization/profile and speed-aware road preview so 36 m/s scenarios can be represented without the M3221 channel saturation/preview blocker. This admits no training or driver-performance claim.

seed_discipline.selection_training_or_validation_reuse: none: this is an env-contract smoke, not training, target pricing, selection, or validation

preregistered_readouts.obs_shape: All sampled frames must keep obs72 shape.
preregistered_readouts.high_speed_reach: All sampled frames must have speed_ref >= 35.9 m/s.
preregistered_readouts.legacy_blocker_exposure: The legacy fixed-preview/high-speed fixture must expose the old blocker with ego_vx scaled magnitude >= 1.2 and fixed preview time <= 1.12 s.
preregistered_readouts.scaled_normalization: Across scaled_high_speed and scaled_high_speed_crosser frames, selected audited channels ego_vx, ego_vy, ego_ax, ego_ay, road_y, and obs_rel_vy must have max_abs <= 1.0.
preregistered_readouts.speed_aware_preview: Scaled profiles must keep minimum road preview time >= 2.45 s at 36 m/s.
preregistered_readouts.high_speed_labels: The high-speed moving-crosser fixture must produce non-empty feasibility labels and finite predicted_lateral_offset_at_arrival with obstacle_lateral_velocity != 0 on every sampled frame.
preregistered_readouts.determinism: Same seed plus same scripted actions must reproduce observations, labels, preview distance/time, and termination fields within 1e-7.

decision_rule: Accept B2 smoke iff all readouts pass on the full seed set. Passing closes the M3221 high-speed env-contract blocker only; it does not admit training or performance claims.
runtime_gates: quick smoke passes before the full smoke
default ObservationScaleConfig reproduces the legacy obs72 scaling and fixed 40 m preview
high-speed profile is opt-in through observation_scale plus max_speed_limit
deterministic replay passes on the frozen replay seeds
claim_boundary: B2 high-speed env-contract implementation smoke only; no training, no driver mutation, no validation ranking, no promotion, no driver-performance, no current-sim robustness-result, no high-fidelity sufficiency, no paper, no repair-success, no feasibility-proof, and no self-ID claim.
